Name: AT Some Building Edits 2 - Electric Boogaloo
Author: madishartte
Description:
I'm working on porting over an old building edit by TheMourningStar titled [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3113]Some Building Edits[/url]. It has IMO the best greenhouse .png I've ever seen. I have a few more goals for this mod, such as making seasonal variations and the other obelisks. But right now this is a straight port of the original mod.

GOALS
[list]
[*]Big Shed
[*]Optional Silos
[*]Desert and Island Obelisk
[*]Seasonal Variants
[*]Smooth Out Older Textures
[*]Fix gap on the left side of the farmhouse
[*]Recolors
[/list]
Please excuse my very WIP Riverland farm that I used as an example image for how the buildings look!

Downloads.Description: Resized the greenhouse so it isn't cut off on the right hand side.
